external_collaboration.evidence_quote: Working in partnership with Citizens ZA and the Electoral Commission of South Africa (IEC), the initiative has organised three main gatherings since July, focusing on youth participation, women’s civic engagement and continued education for young Catholics.

Working in partnership with Citizens ZA and the Electoral Commission of South Africa (IEC), the initiative has organised three main gatherings since July, focusing on youth participation, women’s civic engagement and continued education for young Catholics.
This year, the institute is celebrating another milestone in its partnership with Absa Bank, whose support has expanded occupational skills training and entrepreneurship programmes for young people.
